relationships.timid-grecchi: Partner; their abilities complement each other.

periods.summary: Milialia reunites with Ikki at the castle and, along with Timid, is assigned to receive rapid training from him. At Caldia she rides in the helicopter with Ikki as the execution half of his relay-node plan. Ikki identifies Or-Gaule's command-wave origins from the air; Milialia uses her exceptional spatial perception and bullet control to hit those targets with paint rounds, allowing ground forces to capture them without killing. She cannot see the pattern Ikki sees and is humbled by the difference in perception, but she performs the sniping role perfectly. B.B. destroys the helicopter, but Ikki pulls her out and Timid catches them.

key_events.summary: Is selected for Ikki's short-term training.
Marks relay-node soldiers with paint rounds from an unstable helicopter.
Survives the helicopter crash thanks to Ikki and Timid.
